correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated every one of the 262144 masks using private closed-neighborhoods instead of cached/direct swapped-mask dominance. For a dominating mask the only vertices uncovered by deleting v are those privately covered by v, so a defender for u works exactly when that private mask is a subset of N[u]. The repaired statement explicitly requires the initial mask to dominate for this lemma. Adding selections preserves a defense witness for any vertex still outside, hence the secure family is upward closed and single-deletion testing is exact for inclusion-minimality. Computed counts for sizes 8–18 were 1755, 13088, 24624, 24948, 16899, 8316, 3042, 816, 153, 18, 1; no smaller secure masks, total 93660, and minimal counts 1755 and 3224 at sizes 8 and 9 only. Thus the repaired claim reproduces the original true spectra. Also independently reconstructed the ancillary move graphs by testing every unordered optimum pair for two differing bits (and adjacency for slides); all-source BFS gave edges 12798 and 4320, full reachability, and eccentricity histograms {8:1755} and {9:1539,10:216}. Exhausting all 9! point permutations and testing preservation of the nine distinct line triples yields 108 point-preserving automorphisms; since the graph is connected and bipartite, all others arise by composition with the checked incidence duality. The orbit histogram was {27:1,108:8,216:4}. These correct benchmark data are retained but separated from the narrowed claim.
residual_risks: No generalization beyond the specified labelled graph; the exact finite certificate is not a formal-proof-assistant check. The uploaded C++ executable was not run during this audit.

value.rationale: The natural complete labeled size spectrum on a canonical incidence graph describes the feasible-set family beyond a scalar domination number or its optimum relocation graph. In particular the 3224 size-nine inclusion-minimal sets do not contain any minimum set, and no larger inclusion-minimal sets are possible. Their census is not an arbitrary choice of a test slice or an orbit recount; the pair of complete spectra gives reusable exact feasible/minimal benchmarks, including a concrete separation between optimizing and generating all minimal guard configurations.
residual_risks: Value is in these exact finite spectra for this graph, not in a general reconfiguration theorem or a new count of the known optimum class.
